flare.note: 9-slice per frame (NinePatchRect, axis stretch TILE, scale x2) over the card rect grown by card_inset art px a side. Uncommon has its own row; Entwined uses the vine green.

pulse_ring.note: Centred on the glyph; neutral light, modulate by the rarity colour.

spark.note: Trail particles for the card's flight into the Dreams row; modulate by rarity, shrink with the card.
